Four huge ties await, with a 2022 semifinal rematch between France and Morocco, a 40 year old score to settle between Spain and Belgium, a first ever tournament meeting between Norway and England, and defending champions Argentina taking on Switzerland. Swipe for the full quarterfinal schedule.

#pubity #viral #sports #worldcup2026 

France and Morocco meet in a rematch of their 2022 semifinal, which France won 2 to 0 to end the Atlas Lions’ historic run in Qatar. France have never lost to Morocco inside 90 minutes, and victory in Boston would make them only the third nation ever to reach three consecutive World Cup semifinals.

Les Bleus have won all six of their games so far, with Kylian Mbappé’s 7 goals putting him level at the top of the Golden Boot race. Morocco remain unbeaten, having knocked out the Netherlands on penalties before sweeping Canada aside 3 to 0.

#pubity #viral #sports #worldcup2026 

Spain and Belgium have met twice before at a World Cup, and the score is level. Belgium famously beat Spain on penalties in the 1986 quarterfinals, exactly 40 years ago at this same stage, before Spain got revenge with a 2 to 1 win at Italia 90.

Spain arrive in Los Angeles unbeaten in 34 matches and are yet to concede a single goal at this tournament, with five straight clean sheets setting a national World Cup record. Belgium bring the firepower after hammering co-hosts USA 4 to 1 in the Round of 16.

#pubity #viral #sports #worldcup2026 

Norway and England have played each other 12 times, with England winning seven, Norway two, and three draws, but this is the first time the two nations have ever met at a major tournament.

Norway are in a World Cup quarterfinal for the first time in their history after Erling Haaland’s brace stunned Brazil, taking the tournament’s top scorer to 7 goals. England are in their 11th quarterfinal, a total only Brazil and Germany can beat, with Harry Kane chasing Haaland on 6 goals in a huge Golden Boot subplot.

#pubity #viral #sports #worl

Cape Verde's incredible World Cup journey is doing more than making history on the pitch.

The nation's global exposure has sparked a massive surge in travel interest, with analysts predicting the tournament could generate billions in future tourism revenue.

Similar World Cup success stories helped countries like Croatia and Morocco attract millions of new visitors, and many believe Cape Verde could be next.

Would you visit Cape Verde after watching their World Cup run? 🇨🇻✈️👇

For nearly two decades, England's men's national team has quietly donated every match appearance fee to charity.

The tradition began in 2007 when senior players decided their England appearance fees could make a bigger impact helping others than sitting in their own bank accounts. Since then, every player called up to the national team has continued the tradition through the England Footballers Foundation. 

While the individual match fees are relatively small compared to Premier League salaries, the donations have added up to more than £15 million, supporting charities including UNICEF, Help for Heroes, The Bobby Moore Fund, and many other community projects across the UK. 

It's one of football's longest-running charitable traditions, yet many fans still don't know it exists.

For the first time since the tournament began, there is no World Cup football today. The rest day gives the last eight teams a chance to recover before the quarterfinals kick off tomorrow.

Four huge ties await, with a 2022 semifinal rematch between France and Morocco, a 40 year old score to settle between Spain and Belgium, a first ever tournament meeting between Norway and England, and defending champions Argentina taking on Switzerland. Swipe for the full quarterfinal schedule.

France and Morocco meet in a rematch of their 2022 semifinal, which France won 2 to 0 to end the Atlas Lions’ historic run in Qatar. France have never lost to Morocco inside 90 minutes, and victory in Boston would make them only the third nation ever to reach three consecutive World Cup semifinals.

Les Bleus have won all six of their games so far, with Kylian Mbappé’s 7 goals putting him level at the top of the Golden Boot race. Morocco remain unbeaten, having knocked out the Netherlands on penalties before sweeping Canada aside 3 to 0.

#pubity #viral #sports #worldcup2026 

Spain and Belgium have met twice before at a World Cup, and the score is level. Belgium famously beat Spain on penalties in the 1986 quarterfinals, exactly 40 years ago at this same stage, before Spain got revenge with a 2 to 1 win at Italia 90.

Spain arrive in Los Angeles unbeaten in 34 matches and are yet to concede a single goal at this tournament, with five straight clean sheets setting a national World Cup record. Belgium bring the firepower after hammering co-hosts USA 4 to 1 in the Round of 16.

#pubity #viral #sports #worldcup2026 

Norway and England have played each other 12 times, with England winning seven, Norway two, and three draws, but this is the first time the two nations have ever met at a major tournament.

Norway are in a World Cup quarterfinal for the first time in their history after Erling Haaland’s brace stunned Brazil, taking the tournament’s top scorer to 7 goals. England are in their 11th quarterfinal, a total only Brazil and Germany can beat, with Harry Kane chasing Haaland on 6 goals in a huge Golden Boot subplot.
